cards.title: Total Persons
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM persons

cards.title: Total Projects
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM projects

cards.title: Total Staff
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM staff

cards.title: Total Branches
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM branches

cards.title: Attendance Trend (Last 30 Days)
cards.query: SELECT DATE(date) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM attendance WHERE date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(date) ORDER BY date

cards.title: Attendance by Status
cards.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM attendance GROUP BY status

cards.title: Top Branches by Persons
cards.query: SELECT b.name, COUNT(p.id) as count FROM branches b LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.branch_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

cards.title: Recent Persons
cards.query: SELECT id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, branch_id, created_at FROM persons ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
